test_gis_all_layers_can_be_enabled.description: Verify all 20 GIS layers can be enabled, refreshed, hidden, shown and cleared together
test_gis_all_layers_can_be_enabled.steps:
1. Open GIS in Single mode.
2. Clear existing layers when necessary.
3. Add all 20 named layers using the required selection values.
4. Confirm every selected-layer name.
5. Hide and show all layers.
6. Refresh the browser and verify all 20 layers and Single mode remain.
7. Verify the layer actions generated successful API activity, recording the known G900 SS tile-service error as a warning.
8. Use Clear map layers and verify cleanup.
test_gis_all_layers_can_be_enabled.expected: All 20 layers coexist, survive a browser refresh, generate monitored API activity, can be hidden and shown, and can be removed together. The known G900 SS coverage tile 5xx is reported as a warning; all other 5xx responses fail the test.
test_gis_all_layers_can_be_enabled.success_actual: All 20 GIS layers appeared together, survived refresh, generated successful API activity, were hidden and shown, and were cleared.

test_gis_all_layers_can_be_removed_indiv.description: Verify every GIS layer can be removed using its individual control
test_gis_all_layers_can_be_removed_indiv.steps:

2. Add each named layer using any required selection.
3. Confirm its selected-layer name.
4. Use that layer's Remove from selected control.
5. Confirm no selected layer remains.
6. Repeat for all 20 layers.
test_gis_all_layers_can_be_removed_indiv.expected: Each of the 20 GIS layers can be added and then removed individually without affecting the test sequence.
test_gis_all_layers_can_be_removed_indiv.success_actual: Every named GIS layer was added, verified and removed using its own Remove from selected control.

test_gis_configuration_dropdowns_are_ava.success_actual: All enabled GIS configuration dropdown options were selected and verified as active; disabled options were skipped and temporary layers were cleared.

test_zz_no_api_requests_failed.description: Verify the run generated API traffic and no unexpected critical API, network or browser failures
test_zz_no_api_requests_failed.steps:
1. Monitor API XHR/fetch traffic throughout the suite.
2. Confirm that at least one API response was observed.
3. Fail on unexpected HTTP 5xx, authenticated 401/403, non-aborted API network failures or unhandled page errors.
4. Treat the known transient map-rendering message 'Style is not done loading' as a warning.
5. On failure, open API Request Audit, select the configured tester and select 5xx when it is available.
6. Embed that filtered API Audit screenshot in the Word report.
test_zz_no_api_requests_failed.expected: The monitor observes API traffic and no unexpected critical API, network or browser runtime failure occurs; the known non-functional map-rendering warning does not fail the run.
test_zz_no_api_requests_failed.success_actual: API traffic was inspected and no unexpected critical API, network or browser runtime failure was detected; expected invalid-route and map-rendering messages were reported as warnings.

test_zy_api_audit_has_no_5xx_for_current.description: Verify Request Explorer contains no 5xx responses for the current tester and run
test_zy_api_audit_has_no_5xx_for_current.steps:
1. Open API request audit.
2. Disable Live rolling 24 hours.
3. Set the UTC range to the current test run and filter Caller to the configured tester.
4. If Status offers 5xx, select it, refresh, and inspect matching rows and metadata.
5. If Status omits 5xx, record that no 5xx records exist for the selected period.
test_zy_api_audit_has_no_5xx_for_current.expected: Request Explorer contains no HTTP 5xx response for the configured tester during the current automated run; absence of the 5xx filter is accepted as no 5xx records.
test_zy_api_audit_has_no_5xx_for_current.success_actual: The audit either showed no 5xx records after filtering or omitted the 5xx option because no matching server errors existed.
